title: Pakistan Says Deal Is Close Even as Iran, US Harden Stances
summary: Pakistan’s defense minister said the US and Iran are “close to some sort of arrangement” over the Strait of Hormuz, even after both sides appeared to toughen their positions in the long-deadlocked negotiations. Noam Raydan, William Sudhaus Senior Fellow at The Near East Institute says the data  shows that the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea will remain essential choke points.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fmr. FDA, CDC Official on Cyclospora, Food Safety Issues
summary: Steve Ostroff, Former Acting Commissioner of the FDA and Former Deputy Director of the National Center for Infectious Diseases at the CDC, joined the program to discuss the public awareness timeline of the cyclospora outbreak. The conversation highlighted that while the outbreak became widely known in early to mid-July, there were reports suggesting that government agencies had knowledge of the issue weeks prior to public disclosure.
